## Booking requests and AI availability check

A webhook request is validated, then a DeepSeek agent checks the inventory sheet for the requested dates. Confirmed and conflicting bookings are logged, emailed to the renter and posted on Discord.

## Returns and inventory updates

A return is logged to the ReturnsLog tab, the item is matched in the Inventory tab and its booked quantity is released. Damaged, missing or unknown items alert the team and the owner.

## Daily operations sweep

Every morning confirmed bookings are checked for pickups due tomorrow, returns due today and late rentals, then reminders are emailed and a summary or all clear is posted on Discord.

## Weekly operations digest

Every Monday booking, conflict, return and late stats are computed, DeepSeek drafts the digest, and it is emailed and posted on Discord.

## Manage rental equipment bookings and returns with DeepSeek, Google Sheets, Gmail and Discord

### How it works

1. A booking request arrives on a webhook and is validated.
2. A DeepSeek agent reads the Inventory sheet and checks what is free for the requested dates, then drafts the renter message.
3. Confirmed and conflicting bookings are written to the Bookings tab, the renter is emailed and the team is alerted on Discord.
4. A return report arrives on a webhook, is logged to the ReturnsLog tab, and the item's booked quantity is released in the Inventory tab.
5. Damaged, missing or unknown items raise a Discord alert and an email to the owner.
6. Every morning a sweep emails pickup and return reminders, and every Monday a digest with booking, conflict, return and late stats is emailed and posted on Discord.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with Inventory, Bookings and ReturnsLog tabs using the column headers from the workflow nodes
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets, Gmail and Discord credentials
- [ ] Replace the placeholder owner and staff email addresses with your own
- [ ] Point the rental/intake and rental/return webhooks at your booking form or app
- [ ] Set the daily sweep and Monday digest schedules to times that fit your operation

### Customization

Add fields such as a deposit or storage location to the Inventory tab, change the reminder wording, or route the alerts to Slack or Telegram instead of Discord.
